# SBX

> Durable Sessions that run official coding-agent CLIs in isolated executors, capture immutable ChangeSets and deliver them with an exact-subject merge gate. One REST surface under /api.

## Start

- [Introduction](/getting-started/introduction/): what SBX is and is not
- [Quick start](/getting-started/quick-start/): self-host with PostgreSQL and run a first Turn
- [Concepts](/concepts/): Session, Turn, ExecutorLease, Worktree, ChangeSet, Delivery, Delegation, Connection, Job
